entries.name: Implicit VR Little Endian: Default Transfer Syntax for DICOM
entries.notes: Native uncompressed pixel data; required for Phase 1 smoke/core planning.

entries.name: Explicit VR Little Endian
entries.notes: Native uncompressed pixel data; required default for Phase 1 smoke/core planning and Part 10 File Meta Information.

entries.name: Explicit VR Big Endian
entries.notes: Retired transfer syntax. DICOM-rs 0.9.1 provides built-in explicit VR big endian data element decoding and encoding; legacy profile recipe work remains pending.

entries.name: Deflated Explicit VR Little Endian
entries.notes: Dataset deflate is distinct from encapsulated deflated image frame compression. DICOM-rs 0.9.1 provides dataset read/write support when this crate is built with the project `deflate` feature.

entries.name: JPEG Baseline (Process 1): Default Transfer Syntax for Lossy JPEG 8 Bit Image Compression
entries.notes: Generated when the project `jpeg` Cargo feature enables the pinned DICOM-rs JPEG Baseline writer. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout and decoded sample tolerance.

entries.name: JPEG-LS Lossless Image Compression
entries.notes: Generated when the project `charls` Cargo feature enables the pinned DICOM-rs CharLS JPEG-LS Lossless writer. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout and exact decoded frame hashes.

entries.name: JPEG-LS Lossy (Near-Lossless) Image Compression
entries.notes: DICOM-rs 0.9.1 exposes this transfer syntax behind the CharLS feature, but the project deliberately defers generation until a near-lossless error limit, lossy Image Pixel metadata policy, decoded tolerance validation, and reproducibility evidence are selected.

entries.name: JPEG 2000 Image Compression (Lossless Only)
entries.notes: Generated when the project `jpeg2000` Cargo feature enables the project OpenJPEG-rs JPEG 2000 Lossless writer plus the pinned DICOM-rs OpenJPEG reader. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout and exact decoded frame hashes.

entries.name: JPEG XL Lossless
entries.notes: Generated when the project `jpegxl` Cargo feature enables the pinned DICOM-rs JPEG XL Lossless writer, backed by jxl-oxide decode and zune-jpegxl lossless encode. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout and exact decoded frame hashes.

entries.name: High-Throughput JPEG 2000 Image Compression (Lossless Only)
entries.notes: Generated when the project `htj2k_openjph` Cargo feature exposes the OpenJPH external-command wrapper plus the pinned DICOM-rs OpenJPEG-backed HTJ2K reader. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout, exact decoded frame hashes, and runtime executable SHA-256 fingerprint metadata.

entries.name: JPEG Lossless, Non-Hierarchical (Process 14)
entries.notes: Generated when the project `legacy_jpeg_dcmtk` Cargo feature exposes the DCMTK dcmcjpeg external-command wrapper plus the pinned DICOM-rs JPEG Lossless Process 14 reader. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout, exact decoded frame hashes, and runtime executable SHA-256 fingerprint metadata.

entries.name: JPEG Lossless, Non-Hierarchical, First-Order Prediction (Process 14 [Selection Value 1]): Default Transfer Syntax for Lossless JPEG Image Compression
entries.notes: Generated when the project `legacy_jpeg_dcmtk` Cargo feature exposes the DCMTK dcmcjpeg external-command wrapper plus the pinned DICOM-rs JPEG Lossless SV1 reader. Default builds report dependent cases as feature-gated unavailable; feature builds validate encapsulated Pixel Data layout, exact decoded frame hashes, and runtime executable SHA-256 fingerprint metadata.

entries.name: Deflated Image Frame Compression
entries.notes: Generated when the project `deflate` Cargo feature enables the pinned DICOM-rs Deflated Image Frame adapter. The first case is a binary multi-frame Segmentation object with one fragment per frame and exact decoded bit-packed frame hash validation.

entries.name: RLE Lossless
entries.notes: RLE Lossless generation uses the native project-owned byte-stable RLE frame encoder and the project encapsulated Pixel Data substrate. DICOM-rs 0.9.1 supplies dataset write support for the transfer syntax; pixel encode capability is provided by this project, not by the DICOM-rs pixel writer.
